label: A two-world, one-individual S5 model satisfies Scott's A1a, A1b, A2, A3 and A4 and makes a…
meaning: New finite countermodel to sufficiency of the remaining Scott/AFP axioms for A5 or T3. The model satisfies all positivity principles except A5, on an S5 frame, and realizes the possible-God-like corollary C. This is a result about formal assumption independence, not a refutation of all versions of the ontological argument and not an assertion that the semantic model describes metaphysical actuality.
